name: The Café
description: Breakfast and lunch made to order, plus catering for groups, in Leavenworth, Kansas.
_comment_social: Public handles. Used by the menu tri-fold and the /studio/ social pieces; the QR art in assets/qr-facebook.svg and assets/qr-website.svg encodes these same two URLs.
_comment_repo: The site's public source on GitHub. The /studio/ board's Archive links point into it: an archived piece isn't built, so its source is where it lives.
_comment_owners: The two names on the door. Only the opening post used them (archived 2026-10-09, archive/site-src/studio/fb-opening-day.njk), because a small-town reopening is shared for the people, not the premises. Nothing live reads this now; it stays so that post can come back as it was. There is no team page: the staff do not want photos online.
_comment_ordering: The online ordering page (Square, reached through Cash App: cash.app/$lvcafetogo, set 2026-10-02). Every Order Online button and every 'online ordering is coming soon' line on the site and in the post captions keys off `url`: empty means no button and a coming-soon note, filled means the button. It is an off-site link by design (a custom domain needs a paid Square plan).
_comment_game: Order Up, the phone game at /play (game/README.md). `listed`: false keeps it unlisted (noindex, no link in the footer or on /menu); true takes noindex off and shows both links, and then add https://lvcafetogo.com/play to sitemap.xml by hand. It is also the switch to pull the links in a hurry. `statsUrl`: where the game sends its results (how weeks went, no names); empty means it sends nothing and never offers 'Send in your score'. `askContact`: whether that form also offers an email-or-phone box; false keeps it to a first name. `version` shows on the title screen and goes with every result, so change it when the rules change. `playAt`: the address the share picture and text give for the game (owner 2026-11-13). Leave it lvcafetogo.com/play until play.lvcafetogo.com opens the game (the subdomain added at the host, with its certificate; src/.htaccess sends it to /play), then change it to play.lvcafetogo.com.
_comment_opening: Opening day (2026-10-05) and the hours. The hours fields (hoursDays, opens, closes, hoursLabel) are read all over the site, the menus and the posts, so they are stated once here. dayName and monthDay are read by /about. date, kicker and ordinal were only for the opening-week posts, archived 2026-10-09 in archive/site-src/studio/; they stay so those posts can come back as they were. Not billed as a grand opening: that is a separate, later piece.
_comment_closed: Weekdays the cafe is closed (holidays): `date` is YYYY-MM-DD, `name` finishes 'Closed for Veterans Day', `back` is the next day open and `thanks` an optional line for the post and sign. Every page shows 'Closed for Veterans Day, Wednesday, November 11' for the two weeks before (partials/site/closed-notice.njk, gone once the day has passed) and /reserve refuses the day (main.js, and CLOSED_DAYS in kitchen/google-script/Code.gs: change both). The post (studio/fb-closed.njk) and the door sign (studio/sign-closed-bw.njk) read this entry by their `closedDate`, and both show that week, Monday to Friday, open or closed. Online ordering, DoorDash and the Google Profile are set by hand. A past day can stay here; it's never shown.

closedDays.name: Veterans Day
closedDays.thanks: Thank you to everyone who has served.

_comment_construction: Set to false to remove the under-construction banner from every page at once.
_comment_survey: Where /survey sends its answers (Formspree, by email). It shares the newsletter form on /contact until a form of its own is made in Formspree: swap the URL here and every survey link follows. Survey emails carry the subject 'Customer survey'. Mind Formspree's monthly submission limit on the free plan, which is shared across every form on the account.
_comment_reviews: googleUrl: Google's Reviews page for the cafe (by its Place ID), client 2026-11-10: the reviews and their 4.6 stars, with 'Rate and review' stars at the top to tap. Opens without signing in (checked at phone size 2026-11-10); Google asks for an account only to post. Before it: the share link (share.google/iYKUKysNoQKn4htkB, 2026-10-30) only opened a Google search for The Cafe Leavenworth, and the Profile's own review link (g.page/r/CbikGAbx2IFUEBM/review) opens just the write-a-review box, and for anyone signed out Google's sign-in page first. /review (src/review.njk) forwards to it, and that is what printed QR codes use. Empty means no 'Leave a Google review' button anywhere (the survey's thank-you, /feedback) and /review goes to the survey. Ask everyone, good or bad, and never offer anything for a review: Google removes reviews gathered by asking only happy customers or by a reward.
_comment_web3forms: Web3Forms (moving off Formspree, 2026-10-06): the catering form's access key. Public by design: it only says which inbox to send to, so it's fine in this repo. Submissions go to form@lvcafetogo.com, which forwards to the cafe's Gmail; Web3Forms keeps them only about 30 days, so the email is the record. Free plan: 250 submissions a month.
_comment_reservations: Table requests from /reserve go to a Google Apps Script on the cafe's Google account (kitchen/google-script/Code.gs, set up as in kitchen/README.md, 'Reservations'), which keeps them in a Google Sheet, emails the cafe and hands them to the kitchen PC. formUrl is that script's web app address (public by design, like a form endpoint; the PC's key is never here). Empty means /reserve shows the phone number instead of the form. holdMinutes and the seating times are said on the page and must match Code.gs (HOLD_MINUTES, FIRST_TIME, LAST_TIME, MAX_AHEAD_DAYS).
_comment_phoneOrders: false while the kitchen can't take food orders by phone (client, 2026-10-02: not for the first few weeks after opening, for capacity). Every 'call ahead' line on the site and in the generated post captions is conditional on this, so flipping it to true turns them all back on. Catering inquiries by phone are separate and always shown.
